services.name: Home evaluation
services.story: The main story: Max's home evaluation with Caleb. Nothing is taken. The office bills the family's health plan its own way.

services.name: Home evaluation
services.story: The same visit, paid by the family itself: a card is saved, and the $179 is charged when Caleb texts DONE. Free to cancel until 7am on the day; after that, an $89 fee only if Sam confirms it.

services_shape: one client with one therapist at a time, each visit with a set length; every new client starts with an evaluation by a speech therapist; the evaluation sets the plan of care (how many sessions a week, for how many weeks), and those sessions are booked as a weekly plan with the parent's or client's own yes, or one at a time
questions_before_times: who it's for: your child (and their age), or you
for a child: are you the parent or legal guardian (often clear from 'my daughter')
what it's about, in a few words: speech and language, stuttering, voice, or feeding and swallowing (it sets the evaluation and its length; never the details)
languages spoken at home (a therapist who speaks it, or an interpreter)
a school plan (IEP) for speech: none, has one and wants private too, or wants the school's services
a doctor's referral: yes, or not yet
a health plan (its name only), Medicaid, or paying yourself
for a video session: which state the client will be in during the session
days and times that suit you, like after preschool
safety_stop: sudden trouble speaking or understanding, a drooping face, or weakness on one side (stroke signs), at any age
choking now, trouble breathing, turning blue, or a child who can't swallow at all
first_steps: Intake, consent and health history forms
A written price estimate for self-pay families
The plan's OK for the sessions after the evaluation
license: always: each speech-language pathologist (a speech therapist) holds their own active license from the state's board; a speech therapy assistant or a clinical fellow works only with the credential the state's form asks for, if any
staff_skills: speech therapists: evaluations, re-checks, the plan of care, and every session; assistants: sessions only, under a speech therapist's plan of care, where the state allows; feeding and swallowing work only by a therapist trained for it (Iris, Caleb); each therapist's languages (Iris: Spanish); only people cleared for home visits go to homes and preschools; hearing tests only by an audiologist
messages_never: texts carry only the practice's name, the date, the time, the address and a secure link: never the child's name, the visit type, the reason, the plan, test results or health details; at the clinic, no therapist's name in a family's texts; at home, the therapist's name stays, for the door check
demo_note: Demo data for testing only. [G] = prefilled from the business's Google listing at sign-up; the owner checks each field.
